name: Gaussian Splat Data Packing and Compression
definition: Converts raw InputSplatData arrays (from SPZ/PLY files) into compressed GPU-ready byte buffers stored in RuntimeSplatData. All jobs are Burst-compiled and have zero Editor dependencies, safe to call at runtime in builds.
summary: Gaussian Splat Data Packing converts raw splat arrays into compressed GPU buffers using Morton reordering for cache coherence and aggressive quantization.
